translations.english: (The Pushpaka) was designed by dint of divine efforts and prowess (of Kubera). It could touch any place its master commanded with a cool mind. It had many beautiful places of rest.
translations.hindi: उत्तमं राक्षसावासं हनुमानवलोकयन्‌ । ाससादाथ लक्ष्मीवान्राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशनम्‌ ।। ४ ` हनुमान जी राक्षसों के उत्तम गृहों को देखते हुए, रावण के राजभवन में पहुँचे
